points.note: Sets the maximum capacity that the chiller can use. · 범위 0% to 120% · 기본 100%

points.name: Hot Water Setpoint

points.name: Base Loading Setpoint

points.name: Run Enabled

points.name: Local Setpoint Control
points.note: Indicates if the chiller is being controlled by local setpoints instead of BAS setpoints. · Inactive =Remote Control Active = Local Control

points.name: Capacity Limited

points.name: Condenser Water Flow Status
points.note: Condenser water flow status. · Inactive = No Flow Active = Flow

points.name: Head Relief Request
points.note: Indicates if the chiller is asking an outside system to provide more heat rejection from the condenser water loop. · Inactive = Off Active = On

points.name: Base Loading Active
points.note: Indicates if the base loading control method is currently being used. · Inactive = Inactive Active = Active

points.name: Compressor 1A Running

points.name: Evaporator Water Pump Request
points.note: Indicates a request from the chiller to turn on the evaporator water pump. · Inactive = Off Active = On

points.name: Condenser Water Pump Request
points.note: Indicates a request from the chiller to turn on the condenser water pump. · Inactive = Off Active = On

points.name: Evaporator Water Flow Status
points.note: Indicates if water is flowing through the evaporator. · Inactive = No Flow Active = Flow

points.name: Alarm Present

points.name: Shutdown Alarm Present
